### .research

Currently, I am using meta-analysis to look for “original discoveries and contributions by mining
the untapped veins of information in accumulated research literatures.” ([Hunter & Schmidt 2004,
p. 21][6])

In general, I believe that research is inherently cross-disciplinary:
* Data science helps us to distill interesting patterns from human behavior.
* Qualitative research helps us to understand the meaning of these patterns.
* Experimental research and design research help us to use this understanding to build more
  effective information systems.

# Data Mining Fruitful and Fun

Open source machine learning and data visualization.

[Download Orange 3.40.0][8]

[[Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented]][10]

We explored what the gnomes are doing together with the youngest primary school students and had a
lot of fun along the way.

[[Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students]][12]

Dec 31, 2025

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to turn Orange into an interactive data exploration tool.

[[Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows]][14]

### [Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows][15]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to annotate workflows in Orange.

[[Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows]][16]

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.

## FAQs about Ecommerce CFOS

Find answers to the most common questions eCommerce founders are wondering about.

[ Read more FAQs ][26]
[ 1. Why CFO Expertise over other CFOs?
][27]

If you're an Ecommerce or D2C brand selling primarily on Shopify and/or Amazon, CFO Expertise was
founded specifically for you. We have 10+ years of experience catering to Ecommerce CFO needs and we
hold that as our primary focus when helping companies. We're entrepreneurs ourselves so we
understand what it's like to scale companies and we apply that first-hand knowledge to helping with
your finances.

[ 2. How much does a fractional CFO cost?
][28]

Most DTC and Ecommerce brands pay between $3k–$10k per month depending on the complexity and scope
of CFO work. The right way to look at it is ROI: a good CFO should save you multiples of their fee
by preventing mistakes, improving cash flow, and unlocking growth. That's what we aim for at CFO
Expertise for all our Ecommerce clients.

[ 3. What finance work is completed each month?
][29]

We deliver accrual-based financials by the 10th of the month, complete with a full KPI dashboard.
The finance dashboard includes COGS, contribution margin, CAC, LTV, payback, shipping costs, and
overhead trends (depending on what package you sign up for). We'll meet with you to review the
financials, provide insights for future growth, and make suggestions based on the data. In addition,
we take on financial projects as they come up for one-time fees on top of your monthly package. 

[ 4. How many meetings do I get?
][30]

This depends on the package that you sign up for. For the majority of our clients, we meet 1-4+
times each month to review financials and work on special projects. For our most basic package,
there aren't any scheduled meetings each month. Instead, you receive a monthly video walkthrough of
your dashboard from your CFO. Additional meetings can always be purchased for a one-time fee.

[ 5. Who is a fractional CFO best for?
][31]

At CFO Expertise, we cater primarily to high-growth Ecommerce and DTC brands doing $1M–$50M+ in
revenue that sell on Shopify and/or Amazon and need financial clarity and cash flow discipline.
We're most ideal for founders who are great at sales and brand-building, but want a strategic
partner to connect finance, marketing, and ops.

[ 6. Can you help me prepare for an exit?
][32]

Yes, of course! A high percentage of our Ecommerce clients are scaling toward acquisition or private
equity. We help you clean up financials, structure your data room, maximize EBITDA, and model
valuations. The goal is simple: make you look bulletproof to buyers.

Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

## Trusted and used by 1.3+ million websites and apps

## All together. All connected.

Why settle for one tool, when you can have it all? Give your team the tools they need to deliver
experiences that convert, every time.

Heatmaps

**Find new ways to improve any page**

See where users move, click, and scroll. Identify what’s working—and what’s not—on every page.
Combine heatmaps with feedback to answer tough questions about visitor behavior.

Session Replay

**See what your users see**

Watch real user journeys to quickly spot bugs, confusion, and drop-offs. Get a one-click summary
that highlights key moments so you can quickly spot issues. Connect replays with heatmaps and survey
responses to get the full picture of what people experience.


Funnels

**Visualize user drop-offs across key journeys**

See where users drop off, why, and what to do next. Compare funnels across devices or segments, or
just ask Sense to pinpoint blockers for you

Surveys

**Collect and analyze user feedback**

Create surveys in seconds and get responses in minutes with 40+ templates and the AI survey
generator. Quickly understand results with AI summary reports and sentiment analysis, and invite
respondents to follow-up interviews with a click.

User tests

**Get unfiltered feedback on sites and prototypes**

See how people interact with your website, product, or early designs—in their own time, no moderator
required.

## Everything you love about Hotjar. Now with more power.

Hotjar has joined forces with Contentsquare, alongside Heap, to build a more powerful experience
intelligence platform. Soon, you’ll have more ways to understand your users, and improve every step
of their journey.

Hotjar’s core capabilities aren’t going anywhere. Heatmaps, Recordings (known as Session Replay in
Contentsquare), surveys, and feedback tools are still here—easy to use and fast to set up. Product
Analytics from Heap is on the way and will roll out over time. Stay tuned!

## FAQs

### What is Kalodata and why should I use it?

Kalodata is a data analytics and insights tool for TikTok shop. By providing information on trending
products, talented influencers, trending short videos, quality livestreams, market research,
competitive analyses, we can help TikTok shop sellers/brands/creators/affiliates make better and
data-driven decisions to increase their sales and revenues, as well as boost the efficiency of
day-to-day operations.

### How does Kalodata get its data, and how accurate is it?

Kalodata gathers TikTok e-commerce data by having our tech team collect information from public
channels. We then use advanced AI models and data processing techniques to refine this data. Keep in
mind that certain details, like transaction amounts and ad spending, might have small variations
from real-world numbers. With our models getting trained and updated daily, the accuracy of our data
is continually improving. Our main goal is to help users discover products, stores, and content that
are worth exploring, learning from, and getting inspired by, enabling them to shape well-informed
business strategies. However, it's important not to use our data in situations requiring high
precision, such as partner commission settlements or performance evaluations.

### What is the background of the team?

Our management team came from TikTok's global e-commerce division and were the key members in the
development of TikTok Shop from the beginning. Additionally, our core team consists of professionals
with extensive experience in data analysis, social media, and marketing. The team members have
served renowned enterprises and institutions and possess successful project experience and industry
insights.

### What is the pricing of Kalodata?

Please go to[https://www.kalodata.com/pricing][16].

### Is Kalodata affiliated with TikTok Shop?

No. Kalodata is an independent SaaS analytics platform operated by Kalowave Technology Co., Limited.
Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with TikTok,
TikTok Shop, or ByteDance. TikTok and TikTok Shop are trademarks of their respective owners and are
referenced only to describe the e-commerce ecosystem, marketplace, and data categories analyzed by
Kalodata.

### Does Kalodata have an affiliate program?

Yes! We welcome content creators and community leaders to join our affiliate program. Please[contact
us][17]for more details.

Disclaimer: Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated
with TikTok, TikTok Shop, or ByteDance.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

## Why Meesho sellers lose money without knowing.

Meesho's Supplier Panel hides your real cost overheads. Between commissions, ad burns, RTO fees,
penalties, and taxes — your true profit is a black box.

### Hidden Deductions

Commission fees, penalties, and packaging charges are deducted automatically. Meesho takes 15% to
40% off your top-line sales silently.

### RTO Return Penalties

Every customer return and RTO costs you two-way logistics and packaging fees. Without SKU tracking,

## FAQs about Ecommerce CFOS

Find answers to the most common questions eCommerce founders are wondering about.

[ Read more FAQs ][26]
[ 1. Why CFO Expertise over other CFOs?
][27]

If you're an Ecommerce or D2C brand selling primarily on Shopify and/or Amazon, CFO Expertise was
founded specifically for you. We have 10+ years of experience catering to Ecommerce CFO needs and we
hold that as our primary focus when helping companies. We're entrepreneurs ourselves so we
understand what it's like to scale companies and we apply that first-hand knowledge to helping with
your finances.

[ 2. How much does a fractional CFO cost?
][28]

Most DTC and Ecommerce brands pay between $3k–$10k per month depending on the complexity and scope
of CFO work. The right way to look at it is ROI: a good CFO should save you multiples of their fee
by preventing mistakes, improving cash flow, and unlocking growth. That's what we aim for at CFO
Expertise for all our Ecommerce clients.

[ 3. What finance work is completed each month?
][29]

We deliver accrual-based financials by the 10th of the month, complete with a full KPI dashboard.
The finance dashboard includes COGS, contribution margin, CAC, LTV, payback, shipping costs, and
overhead trends (depending on what package you sign up for). We'll meet with you to review the
financials, provide insights for future growth, and make suggestions based on the data. In addition,
we take on financial projects as they come up for one-time fees on top of your monthly package. 

[ 4. How many meetings do I get?
][30]

This depends on the package that you sign up for. For the majority of our clients, we meet 1-4+
times each month to review financials and work on special projects. For our most basic package,
there aren't any scheduled meetings each month. Instead, you receive a monthly video walkthrough of
your dashboard from your CFO. Additional meetings can always be purchased for a one-time fee.

[ 5. Who is a fractional CFO best for?
][31]

At CFO Expertise, we cater primarily to high-growth Ecommerce and DTC brands doing $1M–$50M+ in
revenue that sell on Shopify and/or Amazon and need financial clarity and cash flow discipline.
We're most ideal for founders who are great at sales and brand-building, but want a strategic
partner to connect finance, marketing, and ops.

[ 6. Can you help me prepare for an exit?
][32]

Yes, of course! A high percentage of our Ecommerce clients are scaling toward acquisition or private
equity. We help you clean up financials, structure your data room, maximize EBITDA, and model
valuations. The goal is simple: make you look bulletproof to buyers.

## Commerce Analytics Tool

и помогает принимать эффективные решения для онлайн торговли (e-com).

## Услуги e-com (онлайн торговля)

На базе собственной экспертизы в аналитике
и возможностей Commerce Analytics Tool можем оказать следующие услуги:

[Оставить заявку на услугу][11]
* [svg]
  
  ### Аналитика категорий на площадках
  
  Делаем глубокую аналитику по каждой площадке и бренду внутри категорий. Проводим анализ
  распределения товаров по вкладу в прибыль (ABC анализ) категорий и находим потенциальные точки
  роста.
* [svg]
  
  ### Медийная поддержка
  
  Подбираем наиболее эффективные форматы внутри площадок с прогнозом по  рентабельности расходов на
  рекламу (ROAS). Реализуем аудиторный подход для ведения внешнего трафика на продуктовую карточку.
* [svg]
  
  ### Подготовка контента для продуктовых карточек
  
  Делаем 360 фото и видео товаров. Адаптируем фото-контент под площадки. Разрабатываем наиболее
  эффективное описание продуктовых карточек внутри площадок. Создаем расширенное мультимедийное
  описание товара (rich-контент).
* [svg]
  
  ### Выведение карточек товара в ТОП выдачи
  
  Определяем основные факторы, которые влияют на выдачу на конкретной площадке. Управляем ставками
  по товарам на площадках. Проводим оптимизацию для поисковых движков (SEO) продуктовых карточек
  и используем возможности площадок для повышения позиций.
* [svg]
  
  ### Динамическое ценообразование
  
  Разрабатываем промо-календарь. Настраиваем автоматическое управление ценой на базе 50+ параметров.
  Удерживаем целевую маржинальность при максимизации продаж.
* [svg]
  
  ### Работа с репутацией
  
  Разбираем все отзывы в категории и анализируем атрибуты, на которые нужно обратить внимание.
  Нативно генерируем отзывы на площадках. Отвечаем от лица бренда.
* [svg]
  
  ### Комплексная стратегия и консалтинг

* [svg]
  
  ### Аналитика категорий на площадках

  роста.
* [svg]
  
  ### Медийная поддержка
  
  Подбираем наиболее эффективные форматы внутри площадок с прогнозом по  рентабельности расходов на
  рекламу (ROAS). Реализуем аудиторный подход для ведения внешнего трафика на продуктовую карточку.
* [svg]
  
  ### Подготовка контента для продуктовых карточек

  эффективное описание продуктовых карточек внутри площадок. Создаем расширенное мультимедийное
  описание товара (rich-контент).
* [svg]
  
  ### Выведение карточек товара в ТОП выдачи
  
  Определяем основные факторы, которые влияют на выдачу на конкретной площадке. Управляем ставками
  по товарам на площадках. Проводим оптимизацию для поисковых движков (SEO) продуктовых карточек
  и используем возможности площадок для повышения позиций.
* [svg]
  
  ### Динамическое ценообразование
  
  Разрабатываем промо-календарь. Настраиваем автоматическое управление ценой на базе 50+ параметров.

* [svg]
  
  ### Работа с репутацией
  
  Разбираем все отзывы в категории и анализируем атрибуты, на которые нужно обратить внимание.
  Нативно генерируем отзывы на площадках. Отвечаем от лица бренда.

seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.

product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

## FAQs

### What is Kalodata and why should I use it?

Kalodata is a data analytics and insights tool for TikTok shop. By providing information on trending
products, talented influencers, trending short videos, quality livestreams, market research,
competitive analyses, we can help TikTok shop sellers/brands/creators/affiliates make better and
data-driven decisions to increase their sales and revenues, as well as boost the efficiency of
day-to-day operations.

### How does Kalodata get its data, and how accurate is it?

Kalodata gathers TikTok e-commerce data by having our tech team collect information from public
channels. We then use advanced AI models and data processing techniques to refine this data. Keep in
mind that certain details, like transaction amounts and ad spending, might have small variations
from real-world numbers. With our models getting trained and updated daily, the accuracy of our data
is continually improving. Our main goal is to help users discover products, stores, and content that
are worth exploring, learning from, and getting inspired by, enabling them to shape well-informed
business strategies. However, it's important not to use our data in situations requiring high
precision, such as partner commission settlements or performance evaluations.

### What is the background of the team?

Our management team came from TikTok's global e-commerce division and were the key members in the
development of TikTok Shop from the beginning. Additionally, our core team consists of professionals
with extensive experience in data analysis, social media, and marketing. The team members have
served renowned enterprises and institutions and possess successful project experience and industry
insights.

### What is the pricing of Kalodata?

Please go to[https://www.kalodata.com/pricing][16].

### Is Kalodata affiliated with TikTok Shop?

No. Kalodata is an independent SaaS analytics platform operated by Kalowave Technology Co., Limited.
Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with TikTok,
TikTok Shop, or ByteDance. TikTok and TikTok Shop are trademarks of their respective owners and are
referenced only to describe the e-commerce ecosystem, marketplace, and data categories analyzed by
Kalodata.

### Does Kalodata have an affiliate program?

Yes! We welcome content creators and community leaders to join our affiliate program. Please[contact
us][17]for more details.

Disclaimer: Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated
with TikTok, TikTok Shop, or ByteDance.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

Is it really possible to delete all my data from the internet?

majority of it. Our guides walk you through deleting accounts, opting out of data brokers, and
requesting data removal under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws.
How are privacy scores calculated?
We evaluate companies across five categories: data collection scope, encryption practices,
third-party data sharing, user control options, and transparency of privacy policies. Scores range
from 0 (worst) to 100 (best) and are updated quarterly.
Are the alternative apps you recommend really more private?
Yes. Every alternative we recommend is vetted against strict criteria: open-source code (when
possible), minimal data collection, strong encryption, independent audits, and a clear business
model that does not depend on selling user data.
Do I need technical skills to follow your guides?
Not at all. Our guides are written for everyday users. We break down every step with screenshots and
plain-language explanations. More advanced guides are clearly labeled.

Most of our content is free. We offer a premium tier that unlocks in-depth reports, early access to
new guides, ad-free reading, and exclusive tools. A free account lets you save articles and track
your privacy progress.
How often is content updated?
Our editorial team reviews and updates guides every quarter or whenever a platform makes significant

While removing 100% of your digital footprint is extremely difficult, you can eliminate the vast
majority of it. Our guides walk you through deleting accounts, opting out of data brokers, and
requesting data removal under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws.
How are privacy scores calculated?
We evaluate companies across five categories: data collection scope, encryption practices,
third-party data sharing, user control options, and transparency of privacy policies. Scores range
from 0 (worst) to 100 (best) and are updated quarterly.
Are the alternative apps you recommend really more private?
Yes. Every alternative we recommend is vetted against strict criteria: open-source code (when
possible), minimal data collection, strong encryption, independent audits, and a clear business
model that does not depend on selling user data.
Do I need technical skills to follow your guides?
Not at all. Our guides are written for everyday users. We break down every step with screenshots and
plain-language explanations. More advanced guides are clearly labeled.
Is OpenMyAnything free?
Most of our content is free. We offer a premium tier that unlocks in-depth reports, early access to
new guides, ad-free reading, and exclusive tools. A free account lets you save articles and track
your privacy progress.
How often is content updated?
Our editorial team reviews and updates guides every quarter or whenever a platform makes significant
privacy-related changes. Breaking news articles are published as events happen.

[Get in touch][41]
What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

## Why Meesho sellers lose money without knowing.

Meesho's Supplier Panel hides your real cost overheads. Between commissions, ad burns, RTO fees,
penalties, and taxes — your true profit is a black box.

### Hidden Deductions

Commission fees, penalties, and packaging charges are deducted automatically. Meesho takes 15% to
40% off your top-line sales silently.

### RTO Return Penalties

Every customer return and RTO costs you two-way logistics and packaging fees. Without SKU tracking,
returns eat your entire margin.

### Unreconciled Payments

Did Meesho actually payout for every single order marked 'Delivered'? Up to 2% of settlements are
missed or incorrectly adjusted.

### Ad Spend Black Hole

Running supplier ads without knowing your product-level ROAS? You might be spending thousands
pushing SKUs that run at a net loss.

### Blind COGS Calculations

Spreadsheets can't keep up with changing product costs. If you don't calculate your weighted average
COGS, your P&L numbers are incorrect.

### Scattered GST Ledgers

ITR and GST filing requires matching TCS and TDS withholdings across hundreds of files. It's a
massive, expensive compliance headache.

The Warning Signs

## Are you working harder than your revenue reflects?

The cause is rarely effort — it’s how the business is wired. When the parts don’t connect, share
data or carry clear ownership, value leaks at every handoff. Below are the symptoms you feel day to
day. Each is a clue; none is the cause.

### Revenue Leakage

Money is lost at every stage of the journey — silently, with no clear owner.

### Missed Opportunities

Prospects fall through the cracks. No follow-up, no system; the process wins.

### Slow Response Times

Leads go cold in hours, customers wait days. The fastest business wins.

### Poor Visibility

You cannot manage what you cannot see. Untrusted data misdirects decisions.

### Weak Accountability

Activity happens without outcomes. No owner, no consequence, no improvement.

### Customer Churn

Customers leave quietly — nobody watched the signals that warned you.

### Technology Debt

Disconnected systems create duplication, delay and cost at every handoff.

### Founder Dependency

Growth stalls when it depends on one person, not a repeatable system.

### Sales-Led Imbalance

Acquisition outpaces delivery and retention — won at the front, lost at the back.

### Slow Growth

Underperformance compounds. Harder work, smaller returns, no clear why.
